text:
incident-bot: PAGER — generation-latency spike in eu-west-1 (sev=2). Alerts: gen-queue-depth, tail-latency > 1s. Link: https://ops.redwood/internal/incidents/1787654321 :rotating_light:

jordan_oncall: Oncall here, taking ownership. I see gen queue backing up on fastgen instances, starting live tail of logs. :eyes:

elain_ops: @jordan_oncall fyi I already muted noisy alerts and notified infra to avoid noisy paging. Can you confirm customer impact?

jordan_oncall: Initial check — ~12% of requests seeing >1s tail-latency, ~0.5% 5xx. Most traffic in eu-west-1 for small-batch streaming. No widespread error codes yet.

mike_sre: Repro'd a spike on a replicated instance, looks like a KV-cache thrash combined with recent kernel arg tweak. Rolling restart of a canary node in eu-west-1 now.

jordan_oncall: Rolling restart started. I'll keep monitoring queue depth and tail percentiles. If restart clears, we can prepare a status page initial note and avoid broad customer emails.

support_amy: Heads-up — two customers (acct: acme-inc, acct: fluxai) filed alerts asking about slower responses. They asked ETA.

product_lina: Thanks — will prep a brief customer-safe blurb if we need to broadcast. Keep it conservative: mention degraded performance, no data loss.

elaine_ops: Draft initial status page copy below. Please iterate quickly.

```
Initial status (draft):
- Impact: Some requests routed to eu-west-1 may experience increased generation latency and occasional 5xx errors.
- Customer impact: Intermittent slower responses; small percentage of requests may return 5xx. No data loss.
- Mitigation: Oncall performing rolling restarts of canary nodes; routing fallback to eu-central being readied.
- ETA: Monitoring; next update in 20 minutes.
```

mike_sre: Suggest adding fallback note: "We are initiating automatic routing fallback to eu-central for new sessions if latency persists." Also remove concrete ETA until we have signal.

jordan_oncall: Restart finished on canary, queue depth dropping, tail p50/p95 improving. Holding for 5min to confirm.

support_amy: OK to use the draft but update ETA to "next update in 20m" and add contact link to support.

legal_sara: Quick check from legal: fine to publish status page copy as-is. Avoid promising timelines beyond monitoring window.

elaine_ops: Updated draft with minor edits. Pasting suggested publish body:

```
Public update 1 / Investigating (eu-west-1)
We are investigating increased generation latency and a small number of 5xx errors affecting some requests routed to eu-west-1. Our on-call team is performing targeted restarts on impacted nodes and preparing routing fallback to eu-central if needed.

Customer impact: intermittent slower responses; a small percentage of requests may return 5xx. No data loss or compromise of customer data is expected.

Mitigation in progress: rolling restarts of canary instances; automatic routing fallback prepared.

Next update: in ~20 minutes or as the situation evolves.
Contact: https://support.redwood/incident
```

product_lina: LGTM. :thumbsup:

jordan_oncall: Observed one spike of 500s during restart but then stability improved. p95 back to baseline after ~3 minutes. I'll keep the thread open for one more update window.

support_amy: I'll notify the two customers with a short note referencing the status page and linking support.

mike_sre: Recommend we prepare a resolved notice in case things stay stable after next check:

```
Resolved (draft):
The issue causing increased generation latency in eu-west-1 has been resolved. Rolling restarts cleared the queue and automatic routing fallback was not required. We observed a brief uptick in 5xx errors during mitigation but there was no data loss.
If you continue to see issues please contact Support: https://support.redwood/incident
```

jordan_oncall: Confirmed stable for 12 minutes, no further 5xx, queue fully drained. Will publish the initial 'Investigating' update now and gate the resolved notice until we hit 30m stable.

elaine_ops: Publishing initial status page update now. Posting internal note to #eng-oncall and #support with draft.

incident-bot: statuspage:update published: https://status.redwood/incident/1767654321 — update id: u-3342

mike_sre: Monitoring continues. If we stay stable for 30m, I'll hand to postmortem-owner and close the pager.

product_lina: Thx team. Prep quick TL;DR for customers once resolved: small window of degraded latency in eu-west-1, resolved by rolling restarts, no customer data impact.

jordan_oncall: 30m stable reached. Publishing resolved notice now.

elaine_ops: Resolved notice posted and internal resolve message sent to #eng-oncall and #support. Closing incident thread. :white_check_mark:

```
Final resolved message (published):
Resolved — eu-west-1 generation latency
The root cause was a transient KV-cache thrash combined with a kernel arg tweak on a subset of fastgen instances. Rolling restarts resolved the condition and traffic returned to expected latency. A small number of 5xx responses occurred during mitigation but there was no data loss.
We will follow up with a short postmortem documenting the exact sequence and mitigation steps.
Contact Support: https://support.redwood/incident
```

support_amy: I've updated the two impacted customers with the resolved blurb. They appreciated the timely updates.

legal_sara: No further comments.

mike_sre: I'll open the postmortem and link telemetry + restart timeline. Thanks all.

jordan_oncall: Closing out. Great teamwork. :clap:
